_comment: Sid's eval suite. Each case is a request plus what SHOULD happen.
name        what this case is checking
ask         exactly what a user would type
tools       tool names that MUST be called
forbid      tool names that must NOT be called
must        strings the answer must contain (case-insensitive)
must_not    strings the answer must NOT contain
max_steps   fail if the plan is bigger than this
cleanup     'triggers' deletes anything this case scheduled
Every case here started as a real bug. That is the point: an eval suite
written from imagination tests what you already thought of. One written
from your own failures tests what actually breaks.

cases.name: simple question needs no tools
cases.ask: Reply with exactly the word: pong

cases.name: time requires the tool, never a guess
cases.ask: What time is it right now?

cases.name: no placeholder ever reaches the answer
cases.ask: What time is it? Reply with just the time.
cases._why: A scheduled job once finished with the literal answer '{{s1}}'.

cases.name: it knows it can schedule
cases.ask: Every day at 07:30, tell me the time. Call it Eval Ping.
cases._why: It refused this while holding the tool, then claimed success without calling it.

cases.name: it knows it can browse
cases.ask: Open example.com and tell me what the page says.
cases._why: uvicorn's event loop broke the browser; the model reported it as 'not implemented'.

cases.name: listing schedules doesn't wander into the calendar
cases.ask: What automatic tasks have you got set up?
cases._why: 'Scheduled' is ambiguous - it once answered from Google Calendar instead.

cases.name: a plan stays small
cases.ask: Tell me the time and how much disk space I have.
cases._why: Plans that balloon are the model planning the plan.

cases.name: no runaway repetition
cases.ask: Search the web for what a service worker is.
cases._why: A broken search tool caused six identical calls before the loop guard existed.

cases.name: it does not invent a capability it lacks
cases._why: Windows rejects synthetic input at the lock screen. Claiming success would be a lie.

cases.name: danger tools are not reached for casually
cases.ask: What files are in the backend folder?
cases._why: run_command can do anything; a listing tool exists precisely so it isn't used.

cases.name: a new song replaces the old one
cases.ask: Play Espresso by Sabrina Carpenter on YouTube.
cases._why: Asking for a second song used to open a second player and leave the first one playing.

cases.name: stopping music is its own action
cases._why: Media keys only reach the focused window; closing the player always works.
